summary.text: Marko Kloos is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Grafton 18, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Donald McFarlane.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a novelist, former IT administrator and bookseller who lives in Enfield.

paragraphs.text: Marko Kloos earned a high school diploma from the Realschule Menden-Lendringsen and has worked as a writer.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has written several bestselling science fiction series, served four years in the West German military, and became a naturalized American citizen in 2004.
He said he lives in the Upper Valley with his wife, two children and three dogs.
Kloos advanced from the Democratic primary for Grafton 18 on September 8, 2026.
In the survey he listed well-funded public education, balancing new housing against local infrastructure in Enfield and Canaan, and the rising cost of living as key messages of his campaign.
